title: Driving into the Future: Multiview Visual Forecasting and Planning with World Model for Autonomous Driving

control_signal.value: frame-wise 3D layouts (3D boxes, HD map, BEV segmentation), text (weather, lighting), ego action sequence, and initial images

control_mechanism.value: unified condition interface: all conditions embedded to d dimensions, concatenated along the token axis, and applied by frame-wise cross-attention in the 3D UNet; 20% condition dropout for classifier-free guidance

base_model.value: latent video diffusion, 3D UNet initialized from Stable Diffusion with added temporal and multiview parameters; view factorization for consistency; 384x192 resolution

datasets.value: nuScenes (700 train, 150 val videos); Waymo Open Dataset used for extra high-resolution generation

metrics.value: FID, FVD, Key Points Matching for multiview consistency; CVT segmentation, 3D detection, online map construction on generated images; planning L2 and collision rate

controllability_evidence.value: Perception models run on generated images (numbers not in packet); qualitative layout and action control. Tree planning with both rewards gives avg L2 0.80 m, collision 0.26% (Table 4).

closed_loop.value: Planning-in-the-loop: world model imagines futures for planner-sampled trajectories, reward picks one, tree rollout repeats; evaluated with open-loop L2 and collision metrics. Horizon in steps not stated in packet.

notes: Packet has no limitations passage. Controllability numbers for generation are absent from the packet.
